title: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours i
question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM category c
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id
WHERE ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(f.rental_duration) DESC
LIMIT 1;
